[IDSP.6.1] LCRS is authoritative here (see LCRS.3 + LCRS.7).
A call's correlation is its `as` value, or, for a call
with none, one generated per activation from the
engine's correlation counter ([LCRS.3.1], [LCCO.3.4]).
Either way it is evaluated before the dispatcher is
entered. Timeouts are adapter-side. The dispatcher does
not allocate correlation IDs, sweep deadlines, or
synthesise timeout responses.
